app.footer: This is an unofficial project. Quota days use UTC; rely on official OpenAI billing data for billing decisions.
app.name: OpenAI Free Credit Tracker

dashboard.cache_write_estimate_incomplete: Cache-write tokens were reported, but their premium cannot be determined precisely by this list-price estimate. This estimate is not a bill; rely on the Costs API.
dashboard.cost_note: An estimate is not a bill. OpenAI's Costs API is the source for actual cost.
dashboard.costs_partial: Usage succeeded, but the Costs API is temporarily unavailable.
dashboard.failure_diagnostics: The request did not complete. Use the Request ID with the safe local log; diagnostics never contain the Admin API Key.
dashboard.hero_body: Usage, Costs, and the model catalog are separate sources. Their timestamps and completeness are shown explicitly.
dashboard.hero_title: Understand today's free quota without confusing estimates and bills
dashboard.key_help: The key is never placed in a URL, config file, database, browser storage, or log.
dashboard.loading: Querying the Usage and Costs APIs…
dashboard.no_data: No usage data has been loaded.
dashboard.no_model_usage: This quota group has no usage yet.
dashboard.partial: Usage was updated. Costs remain separate because that source is temporarily unavailable.
dashboard.price_tooltip: List price per million tokens: input US${input}, cached input US${cached}, output US${output}. Example cost US${sample}.
dashboard.ready: Enter an Admin API Key to query. The key stays in memory for this request only.
dashboard.success: Usage and Costs data were updated.

history.empty: After a sync, UTC daily history will appear here.
history.invalid_range: The date range is invalid. End date cannot precede start date.
history.missing_point: {day}: missing data; the trend line is broken.
history.partial_point: {day}, {group}: partial value {count}; not connected as complete data.
history.title: Usage history
history.trend_empty: Daily accessible trends appear after a sync.
history.trend_summary: {days} UTC days: {complete} complete, {partial} partial, {missing} missing. Partial and missing days break the line.

profiles.credential_notice: After validation, the key is stored only in the OS credential service; the app keeps an opaque reference.
profiles.description: Each profile has its own system credential and data scope; organizations are never mixed.
profiles.empty: No profiles exist. You can still make a one-time query from the Dashboard without saving a key.
profiles.title: Organization profiles

profile.delete_final_confirmation: Second confirmation: attempt to delete profile {name} now? The backend will still block deletion if it is active or has retained data.
profile.delete_scope_confirmation: Review the deletion scope for {name}: {credential} Profile metadata is removed only when allowed. The active config selection, usage history, alert rules, and notification history are never cascade-deleted and can block this operation. Continue to the final confirmation?
profile.delete_scope_credential: Its secure credential will be removed after metadata deletion succeeds.

alerts.description: Notifications are sent only for a new threshold crossing while data is fresh. Restarts and repeated syncs do not cause duplicates.
alerts.title: Quota alerts

credential.invalid: Enter a valid organization Admin API Key.
credential.missing: This profile has no saved credential.
credential.remove_confirmation: Remove the secure credential for {name} and disable background sync? History will be preserved.

settings.invalid_monitoring: The interval must be at least 300 seconds, and maximum data age cannot be shorter than the interval.
settings.reset_already_default: All editable settings already match the defaults.
settings.reset_applied: Editable non-sensitive settings were restored to defaults. Profile selection, credentials, and history were preserved.
settings.reset_confirmation: Restore the previewed editable settings to defaults? Profile selection, credentials, and history are outside this operation.
settings.reset_preview: Preview only. These fields will change: {fields}. Nothing has been saved yet.
settings.reset_safe_scope: Only editable non-sensitive settings are reset; profile selection, credentials, and history are unaffected.
settings.reset_unavailable: Defaults are unavailable, so no settings were changed.
settings.saved: Settings were saved and applied safely.
settings.saved_restart: Settings were saved. Restart to apply: {fields}
settings.title: Application settings

update.confirm_download: Download authenticated update {version}? This does not install it.
update.confirm_install: Install authenticated update {version}? The app may restart and will roll back if its health check fails.
update.confirm_resume: Resume the interrupted update recovery now?
update.critical: This release is marked critical, but still requires your consent.
update.current: This channel is up to date.
update.installation_unavailable: Automatic installation is unavailable for this package. You may still download and verify the release.
update.not_configured: This build has no production update source configured.

state.available: Authenticated version {version} is ready for download consent.
state.committed: Version {version} passed its health check. Restart the app if prompted.
state.downloading: Downloading version {version} into the managed cache.
state.health_check: Checking the installed version before committing.
state.manual_recovery: Automatic rollback could not finish. Stop the app and follow the recovery guide.
state.rolled_back: The update did not pass safely and the previous version was restored.
state.staged: Version {version} is verified and staged; installation still requires consent.

retention.confirm: Permanently delete {count} rows at or before {cutoff}? This cannot be undone.
retention.default_safe: History is never deleted automatically; preview and confirm are both required.
retention.invalid_days: Enter a retention period from 1 to 3650 days before previewing.
retention.preview_result: Preview only: {count} rows at or before {cutoff}. Nothing has been deleted.
retention.stale: History changed after this preview. Nothing was deleted; create a new preview.

operations.integrity_failed: Database integrity failed. Writes have stopped; follow the recovery guide.

notification.history_empty: There is no notification history for this profile.
notification.test_body: Desktop notifications are available. No profile name or credential is included in this test.
notification.test_privacy: The test uses generic text and includes no profile name or credential information.
notification.test_sent: The generic test notification was sent.
